import datetime, re

# reuse simple_note access_token if present; else login
if 'access_token' not in globals() or access_token is None:
    creds = {c['account_name']: c['password'] for c in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()}
    simple_token_resp = apis.simple_note.login(username='kri-powe@gmail.com', password=creds['simple_note'])
    access_token = simple_token_resp['access_token']

now = datetime.datetime.now()
yesterday = now.date() - datetime.timedelta(days=1)
yesterday_str = yesterday.isoformat()
print('yesterday:', yesterday_str)

all_notes = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    resp = apis.simple_note.search_notes(access_token=access_token, query='Friends Dinner', page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit, sort_by='-updated_at')
    if not resp:
        break
    all_notes.extend(resp)
    page_index += 1
print('Friends Dinner notes found:', len(all_notes))
for n in all_notes:
    created_date = n.get('created_at','')[:10]
    print(n['note_id'], n['title'], 'created_at', created_date)

# select candidates from yesterday (or if none, take all)
candidates = [n for n in all_notes if n.get('created_at','')[:10] == yesterday_str]
if not candidates:
    candidates = all_notes
print('candidates:', [(n['note_id'], n['title']) for n in candidates])

for n in candidates:
    note = apis.simple_note.show_note(access_token=access_token, note_id=n['note_id'])
    print('--- note content for', n['note_id'], n['title'], '---')
    print(note['content'])

- 1 cup baby spinach, chopped

- Stir in chopped spinach and cook until wilted. Season with dried oregano, salt, and black pepper.
- Remove the skillet from heat and mix in shredded mozzarella cheese.
- Make a pocket in each chicken breast by cutting a slit horizontally. Stuff the pockets with the spinach and mushroom mixture.
